name: Courchevel
description: Courchevel is not one resort but four villages, each at a different altitude with a different personality. The collective name covers 1850 (luxury, designer boutiques, Michelin stars), 1650/Moriond (family-friendly, more relaxed), 1550/Village (quiet, traditional, lower prices), and 1300/Le Praz (oldest, most authentic). The higher you go, the more prestigious — and expensive — it gets.

overview.atmosphere: Glamour, luxury, Michelin stars, designer shopping — but also genuinely excellent skiing in the world's largest linked domain.

beyond_skiing.swimming_pool_or_spa: Aquamotion water park + indoor pools at several 5-star hotels
beyond_skiing.ice_skating: Olympic-standard indoor ice rink (built for 1992 Albertville Games) at Forum Centre, skate rental on site
beyond_skiing.paragliding: Tandem paragliding flights from Saulire summit (2,700m) — €€€
beyond_skiing.dog_sledding: Multiple providers — half-day and full-day excursions with huskies
beyond_skiing.snowshoeing: Marked trails through forests and Vanoise National Park
beyond_skiing.snowmobiling: Guided snowmobile excursions after lift closure
beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Bowling 3000 — 6 lanes, child-friendly, at Forum Centre. Cinema in 1850, some screenings in English with subtitles. Gym and fitness centre at Forum + yoga classes at multiple venues
beyond_skiing.events_during_stay: Winter Legacy by Alexis Pinturault, weekly street market, concerts, piano bars

off_piste.off_piste_detail: Col du Fruit, Vallée des Avals (guide essential), Grand Couloir area, Bel Aire tree runs

ski_area.snowpark_note: 1 snowpark in Verdons area. Major parks on Méribel side (Le Park, Moon Park)
ski_area.lift_queues: Verdons/Jardin Alpin area gets very busy. Early starts recommended.

apres_and_nightlife.apres_ski_description: La Folie Douce — live music, dancing on tables, starts 2pm slope-side
apres_and_nightlife.nightlife_clubbing: Le Tremplin (piste base), La Cave des Creux (terrace), Les Caves (nightclub), piano bars in luxury hotels

services.ski_hire_info: Multiple shops in all villages — ski hire from ~€25/day
services.supermarket_notes: Forum Centre (1850), smaller shops in other villages
services.medical_centre_notes: Medical centre in 1850, hospital in Moûtiers (25km)

nearest_airports.note: Private jets only — short runway, famous challenging approach

by_train.eurostar: London to Moûtiers direct in winter (from £99 each way)
by_train.shuttle: Regular bus services from Moûtiers to all Courchevel villages

villages.name: Courchevel 1850
villages.character: The flagship. Designer boutiques (Chanel, LV, Prada, Valentino, Cartier, Saint Laurent), 5-star hotels (Aman Le Mélézin, Cheval Blanc, L'Apogée), 3 Michelin-starred restaurants, private jet airport (Altiport). Ultra-luxury, glamorous, and expensive — but the ski-in/ski-out access and central location are genuinely excellent.
villages.architecture: Mix of luxury chalets and 1970s purpose-built blocks — bling covers the concrete
villages.shopping: Chanel, Valentino, Louis Vuitton, Prada, Cartier, Saint Laurent, Dior — rivals Paris boutiques. Forum Centre has supermarket, pharmacy, sports shops.

michelin: Baumanière 1850 — ★★ Michelin, Chef Thomas Prod'homme, Alpine-Provencal, €€€€
Le Sarkara — ★★ Michelin, Chef Sébastien Vauxion, haute vegetarian pâtisserie, €€€€
signature: Le Tremplin — iconic slope-side bar/restaurant at piste base, see-and-be-seen
La Cave des Creux — piste-side, run by local ski instructors, great terrace with Mont Blanc view

villages.apres: La Folie Douce (iconic afternoon party), Les Caves (nightclub), Le Tremplin (slope-side), Bar des Pistes (Aman), piano bars

villages.name: Courchevel 1650 (Moriond)
villages.character: Family-friendly, more relaxed, less expensive than 1850. Hosts the Aquamotion water park — a major draw for families with children.
attractions: Aquamotion — indoor/outdoor water park with heated pools, slides, spa, fitness
villages.dining: Good selection of mid-range restaurants, less formal than 1850

villages.name: Courchevel 1550 (Village)
villages.character: The original hamlet of Courchevel. Quieter, more traditional, lower prices. Good for those who want Courchevel access without the 1850 price tag.

villages.name: Courchevel 1300 (Le Praz)
villages.character: The oldest and most authentic of the Courchevel villages. Traditional Savoyard architecture, quiet, charming. Home to Le Farçon (★ Michelin) and La Tania next door.
villages.dining: Le Farçon — ★ Michelin, rustic-chic, ski-in/ski-out accessible from slopes
villages.note: Most authentic architecture in the Courchevel valley

honest_drawbacks: Expensive — 1850 is one of the most expensive resorts in the Alps
Purpose-built 1970s architecture under the luxury veneer — some areas are dated concrete
Verdons/Jardin Alpin area gets uncomfortably busy
February school holidays are packed and prices spike
Vehicles are restricted — Altiport private jet traffic can be noisy
Lower villages (1300, 1550) need lifts to reach the main ski area
